messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a 'sentinel' sidecar/agent for progressive rollouts. It watches canary signals (p50/p95 latency, error rate, model drift) and can flip traffic with hysteresis. Thoughts?
oliver: What's the boundary between sentinel and runtime? Is sentinel just advisory or can it trigger immediate fallback?
maria: I think sentinel should be authoritative for soft-rollbacks (route to fallback variants) but not for hard decommissions. Runtime keeps last-resort circuit breaker.
sam: We need to avoid oscillation. Suggest two-phase gating: probe window + cooldown. Ex: require 3 consecutive probe windows > threshold before action, then cooldown 10m.
lee: How will routing calls look? Runtime exposes /internal/fallbacks or sentinel mutates route table in control plane?
rachel: Telemetry: need per-tenant breakdown and per-model drift exemplars. Also store representative requests for quick evals.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job 1769123001 completed for sentinel-prototype :white_check_mark:
oliver: Also metrics aggregation — central TSDB vs local sliding windows? Central gives consistency and audit, local is faster for decisions.
maria: Prefer hybrid: local fast path for immediate decisions (short windows), central for trending and audit. All actions logged + reversible via control plane.
sam: Policy language: start with simple YAML DSL for thresholds, allow expression-based metrics later. Policies must be versioned and signed.
lee: Need an idempotent API for runtime to accept 'fallback' command. Suggest POST /internal/fallbacks with request_id, target_variant, scope (tenant/model).
rachel: Add audit events -> console + webhook. Also emit signal to Redwood Optimize so it can suggest quantization/model swaps when fallback patterns occur.
maria: Action items: I'll draft RFC with proto for /internal/fallbacks, policy DSL sketch, telemetry contract. @oliver @sam can you review by EOD Friday? :pray:
oliver: :thumbsup: will review.
sam: Happy to. Add chaos test plan to ensure no accidental mass-fallbacks.
incident-bot: incident-bot: created INF-2317 to track sentinel rollout work
maria: Thanks all. Quick poll: opt-in per-tenant for first stage? Reply yes/no.
lee: yes
rachel: yes
oliver: yes
sam: yes
maria: Great. RFC (draft): https://rwd.internal/rfcs/390-sentinel-rollout-protocol — comments welcome.
